step: Step 4 / KAL-281 — pre-change inventory snapshot (documents rows + documents-bucket storage objects)
restore_sql: -- content_sha256 is the only documents column the backfill writes. To undo the whole backfill:
UPDATE public.documents SET content_sha256 = NULL WHERE id IN (<ids whose content_sha256 was NULL in documents_rows above>);
-- or restore each row's exact prior value:
-- UPDATE public.documents SET content_sha256 = <prior>, file_path = <prior> WHERE id = <id>;
-- file_path is only written by rekey; see step4-kal281-rekey-path-map.json for that mapping.
